newsitem.title: USA: Gulf South Medical CFO to resign.
newsitem.headline: Gulf South Medical CFO to resign.

text.p: Gulf South Medical Supply Inc on Wednesday said Guy Edwards announced his intention to resign as senior vice president and chief financial officer effective June 30, citing his desire to pursue other business interests.

The company said John Vaughan, Gulf South's vice president of finance and controller, would assume the additional role of acting chief financial officer pending a search for a permanent replacement for Edwards.
Edwards will remain a member of the company's board of directors, Gulf South said.
Gulf South Medical Supply is a national distributor of medical supplies and related products to the long-term care industry.
